name: ShredGang
description: ShredGang is a Detroit street gang that forms part of the BandGang/ShredGang (BGSG) association, having aligned with BandGang (formerly MPR JackBoyz) among younger members. The group maintains loose affiliations with West Coast Blood-affiliated sets including the Inglewood Family Gangster Bloods (IFGB), Neighborhood Pirus (NHP), and Centinela Park Family Gangster Bloods (CPFGB). Documented rivals include TNO/826, TTO/886, and 9000GlockBoyz.

sources.title: The Growth and Influence of Gangster Disciples in Detroit – DetroitStreetGangs.com
